title: Lifetime Strength – Season 1
author: Brian B.
desc: Build and preserve the strength, mobility, endurance, and resilience needed to enjoy an active, independent life for decades. Train for capability rather than appearance, pursue mastery through consistent practice, and leave each workout stronger, healthier, and better prepared for whatever life brings next.

ex.note: RPE 4-5 = Brisk pace. You can still hold a conversation.
RPE 5: Move slowly. Keep your lower back gently pressed into the floor.
RPE 3: Slow stretch. Breathe deeply and don’t force the range of motion.

ss.note: RPE 7: Finish with 2–3 reps left. Pull elbows back, don’t lean.
RPE 6: Controlled movement. Stop before your lower back lifts.
RPE 7: Finish with 2–3 reps left. Control every rep.
RPE 7: Finish with 2–3 reps left. Slow lowering, don’t lock knees.
RPE 8: Heavy but controlled. Finish with 1–2 reps (or 10–15 sec) left.

ex.note:
Best Option: Incline Treadmill Walk

* 15 minutes
* Speed: 3.0–3.5 mph
* Incline: 4–6%
* Effort: RPE 4–5
